name: ORA Coding Agent
description: Bridges GitHub and IORA Assist for agentic coding. Mention the bot (e.g. @ora) in a Pull Request to spawn an isolated container that clones the repo, runs the pi coding agent (powered by IORA Assist or an external provider), commits the result and reports back on the PR. Tasks can also be started directly from the app UI, similar to GitHub Copilot.

endpoints.description: GitHub App webhook receiver (issue_comment, pull_request, pull_request_review_comment). Verifies the HMAC-SHA256 signature and triggers an agent run when the bot is mentioned.
List agentic coding tasks with status and metadata.
Start an agentic coding task manually (repo, base branch, prompt, provider, model).
Get a single task with its full result and metadata.
Server-Sent-Events stream of live agent log/event lines for a task.
Cancel a queued or running task.

assist_tools.name: start_coding_task
assist_tools.description: Start an agentic coding task: clone a GitHub repository, run the pi coding agent against a natural-language prompt, commit the result and push a work branch. Use this when the user asks to implement, fix, refactor or change code in a repository.

prompt.description: What the agent should do, in natural language.

base_branch.description: Branch to start from. Defaults to 'main'.

provider.description: Optional pi provider: ora | anthropic | openai | google.

model.description: Optional model identifier for the provider.

assist_tools.name: get_coding_task
assist_tools.description: Get the current status and result (work branch, commit, summary) of a previously started coding task.

assist_tools.name: list_coding_tasks
assist_tools.description: List the most recent agentic coding tasks with their status.

limit.description: Maximum number of tasks to return (1-100, default 20).

assist_tools.name: cancel_coding_task
assist_tools.description: Cancel a queued or running coding task.

task_id.description: The id of the task to cancel.

assist_tools.name: bridge_status
assist_tools.description: Get a live snapshot of the coding agent: task counts, capacity and recent tasks.

assist_tools.name: agent_control
assist_tools.description: Send a control command to the coding agent: ping, get_state, cancel, cancel_all.

task_id.description: Task id (required for the cancel command).

exposed_services.name: ORA Coding Agent
exposed_services.description: Inter-app RPC service to start and query agentic coding tasks from other IORA apps.

methods.name: start_task
methods.description: Start an agentic coding task and return the created task.

methods.name: get_task
methods.description: Fetch the status and result of a coding task by id.

settings_schema.title: ORA Coding Agent Einstellungen
settings_schema.description: Konfiguriere die GitHub App Anbindung sowie die KI-Provider für das Agentic Coding.

fields.label: Bot-Erwähnung (Trigger)
fields.description: Der @-Name, auf den der Bot in PR-Kommentaren reagiert (ohne @).

fields.label: GitHub App ID
fields.description: Die numerische App-ID deiner GitHub App.

fields.label: GitHub App Private Key (PEM)
fields.description: Der private Schlüssel der GitHub App im PEM-Format.

fields.label: GitHub Webhook Secret
fields.description: Das in der GitHub App konfigurierte Webhook-Secret (zur Signaturprüfung).

fields.label: Standard Installation ID
fields.description: Optionale Fallback-Installation-ID, falls der Webhook keine mitliefert.

fields.label: Standard KI-Provider
fields.description: Welcher pi-Provider standardmäßig genutzt wird. Modelle werden dynamisch von IORA Assist abgerufen.

fields.label: Standard Modell
fields.description: Modell-Bezeichner für den gewählten Provider. Modelle werden dynamisch von IORA Assist abgerufen.

fields.label: ORA AI Base URL (OpenAI-kompatibel)
fields.description: OpenAI-kompatibler Endpunkt von IORA Assist, z.B. http://iora-assist:8092/v1

fields.label: ORA AI API Key
fields.description: API-Key für den IORA Assist Endpunkt (falls erforderlich).

fields.label: Ausführungsmodus
fields.description: docker = isolierter Container pro Task (empfohlen). local = Ausführung im App-Container (nur für Entwicklung/Tests).

fields.label: Agent Container Image
fields.description: Docker-Image für den Coding-Agenten (enthält git + pi).

fields.label: Agent Timeout (Sekunden)
fields.description: Maximale Laufzeit eines Agent-Laufs bevor er abgebrochen wird.

fields.label: Inkrementelle Commits
fields.description: Wenn aktiviert, erstellt der Agent nach jedem logischen Änderungsschritt einen eigenen Commit. Ermöglicht einfaches Rollback einzelner Änderungen.

fields.label: Inkrementelles Commit-Intervall (Sekunden)
fields.description: Minimale Wartezeit zwischen zwei inkrementellen Commits.

fields.label: Prompt-Optimierung
fields.description: Wenn aktiviert, wird der Benutzer-Prompt vor der Übergabe an das Hauptmodell von einem leichteren Modell für die KI optimiert.

fields.label: Prompt-Optimierer Modell
fields.description: Leichteres Modell für die Prompt-Optimierung (z.B. ora-default, gpt-4o-mini).

fields.label: Prompt-Optimierer Provider
fields.description: Provider für das Optimierer-Modell (Standard: gleicher Provider wie Hauptmodell).

fields.label: pi.dev Erweiterungen
fields.description: Kommaseparierte Liste von pi-Erweiterungen die im Agent-Container geladen werden. pi-context-tools: Token-Management & Kontext-Komprimierung. pi-codex-goal: Multi-Step Workflow-Tracking.

internal_ports.description: HTTP API, GitHub webhook and UI
